models.name: Google Translation LLM (TLLM)
models.about: Google Translation LLM (TLLM) is the Google Cloud translation model selected for the Zorix Translate comparison. Google documents the model ID as general/translation-llm and describes TLLM as its highest-quality translation model.

models.name: Zorix NexHate 1 Preview (xhigh)
models.about: Zorix NexHate 1 Preview (xhigh) is a Zorix translation preview model. Current published Zorix Translate data records 7.1B requests per five-hour window and a 1007 translation score on the 1000-base scale.
